title: Operations Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 An experienced operations professional responsible for owning end-to-end field operations for digital learning projects across multiple states and districts. Leads a team of operations associates and field coordinators, manages the vendor and logistics ecosystem, and holds accountability for project timelines, quality standards, and budgets. Drives planning, process design, and reporting, while engaging school authorities, government officials, and partner agencies to ensure smooth and efficient project delivery. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own end-to-end planning and execution of field operations for digital learning labs in government and private schools across India. Build and track rollout plans covering timelines, milestones, dependencies, resource allocation, and risk mitigation, and hold accountability for on-time delivery. Lead, coach, and manage a team of Operations Associates and field coordinators, allocating territories, setting goals, and reviewing performance. Identify, onboard, and manage vendors for hardware, infrastructure, accessories, printing, paper, and packaging, including rate negotiation and SLA-based performance management. Oversee logistics and inventory planning, including dispatch scheduling, warehousing, and state-wise, district-wise, and block-wise alignment and reconciliation. Manage the operations budget for assigned projects, control costs, and validate vendor invoices and reconciliations in coordination with Finance. Oversee on-ground coordination with school authorities and internal teams, ensuring smooth installation, configuration, and readiness of digital labs. Ensure site assessments and pre-deployment checks for all lab components (electrical setup, furniture, networking, printing) meet required standards, and conduct periodic quality audits. Design, standardize, and continuously improve documentation, checklists, and operational SOPs for lab readiness and field processes, and drive adoption across geographies. Prepare and present lab readiness and project performance reports to leadership, highlighting installation status, gaps, risks, and action recommendations. Act as the primary operations point of contact for external agencies, partner organizations, and district and state officials for large-scale implementation across multiple districts and states. Own the ticketing and escalation process for hardware, connectivity, and operational issues, monitoring resolution turnaround times and driving root-cause fixes. Ensure compliance with project timelines, operational standards, and client and government reporting requirements. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor s or equivalent degree from a recognized institution. A postgraduate qualification in Operations, Supply Chain, or Management is an added advantage. 3-4 years of relevant experience in operations, logistics, and project management, with demonstrated ownership of multi-location or multi-project delivery. 
 
 Must-have skills 
 Prior experience managing a small team or leading field coordinators is strongly preferred. Proven vendor management experience, including negotiation, SLA tracking, and performance reviews. Strong planning, prioritization, and project management skills, with experience in budget and cost tracking. Strong communication skills in both Hindi and English, with the ability to engage government officials and senior external stakeholders. Ability to connect and coordinate effectively with diverse Internal External teams. Capable of working under tight deadlines in a fast-paced, multi-Project environment while meeting timelines independently. Flexible, proactive, and responsive to dynamic organizational needs. Willingness to travel across project locations as required. Prior experience in a start-up or fast-moving operational environment is preferred. Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; familiarity with project management or ticketing tools is a plus.

description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY GDS – Assurance FAAS – Senior Manager**
 At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 In a world that’s changing faster than ever, our purpose acts as our ‘North Star’ guiding our more than 300,000 people – providing the context and meaning for the work we do every day. In doing so, we play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, clients, and communities. Thanks to our innovative services in auditing, tax consulting as well as transaction and management consulting, we proudly drive our clients into the future.
   

  

 From small businesses to some of the world’s best\-known brands, our clients count on reliable financial statements, information, and processes to inform their ongoing strategies. More than ever, business is about interpreting and reacting to complex data — and they look to us for advice and services they can trust every time. You’ll use your professional skills and experience to make it happen, so whether you’re looking for a long\-term, or are interested in progressing on to other areas, this is a great place to be. As the only one of the Big 4 with a specialist cross‑border practice, we offer our clients seamless, consistent, and high‑quality services around the globe. With our Assurance Services, we strengthen public confidence in global capital markets and promote sustainable growth. If you’re looking to develop your individual skills whilst working in interdisciplinary and multicultural teams, come join us!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for an experienced professional to join EY FAAS, with deep expertise across FAAS solutions and a strong focus on engagements related to transactions and technical accounting governance.
   

  

 The Senior Manager will be responsible for leading a portfolio of complex, high‑impact client engagements, ensuring the timeliness, quality, and delivery of work in line with EY Global Standards. The role requires overseeing multiple engagement teams, driving technical excellence, and acting as a trusted advisor to clients on transaction‑related accounting matters.
   

  

 While the Senior Manager will be based out of one of our EY GDS locations globally, the individual will play a key role in supporting EY practices and clients across global markets, collaborating with onshore teams and senior stakeholders. The individual may also be required to travel internationally on short‑term assignments to support client engagements.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Client responsibilities**
* Lead consulting engagements focused on the planning and execution of Transactions initiatives (including planning and execution of IPOs, and/or the planning and execution of acquisitions and divestitures), looking at a company’s internal finance and accounting processes and advising clients on solutions to increase deal value / benefits, improve processing efficiency, drive automation or reengineer existing processes to better align with future state target operating models;
* Lead business development initiatives including service offering development and roll\-out, proposal development, responding to RFP’s and participating in oral presentations
* Stay informed of changing market conditions and new regulatory developments and their impacts on clients.
* Specialization in our Transactions service offering to provide subject matter expertise and relevant go\-to\-market activities in this area
* Manage the financial and commercial aspects of engagements by organizing staffing, tracking fees and communicating issues to project leaders; and
* Build strong internal relationships within our national and global FAAS practice and across EY’s service lines including Advisory, Tax and Assurance.
* Drive innovation by creating an environment that encourages innovation and being a leader in this area by implementing new and improved ways of working, delivery models and / or technological advancements


**People Management Responsibilities**
* Prioritize the development of people through effective coaching, constructive on\-the\-job feedback and mentoring
* Foster an innovative and inclusive team\-oriented work environment
* Effectively motivate teams with diverse skills and backgrounds
* Conduct performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff
* Lead/contribute to people initiatives including recruiting, retaining and training FAAS professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand, follow, and lead by example as it relates to workplace policies and procedures


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Technical accounting experience in IFRS and US GAAP
* In\-depth knowledge in several of:
+ IPO readiness assessment and management of activities across the IPO lifecycle. Past participation / involvement in an IPO would be an asset
+ Planning and integration of acquisitions across all aspects of Organization / People, Process and Technology including both project management and execution
+ Planning and management of disposals across all aspects of Organization / People, Process and Technology including both project management and execution
+ Audit or business experience in financial statement close

* Highly developed analytical skills focused on business case
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with an ability to think critically and identify creative solutions outside of the box and thrive on new challenges
* Proven track record with a blue\-chip consulting firm in the field or significant equivalent industry experience would be an asset
* Experience in leading and delivering program/projects that cover the full life cycle of assessment, design and implementation support
* Strong spoken and written English skills
* Leading and driving high\-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget
* The ability to lead and work collaboratively in a team environment
* Dedication to teamwork, people development and leadership, with experience in managing and/or mentoring junior staff and providing direction to team members
* Excellent communication skills including verbal, written, and presentation
* A high level of motivation and a self\-starting attitude
* A willingness to travel on short notice to meet client needs


**Professional experience:**
 Typical experience may include, whilst not limited to:
   

  

* Experience of working in a consulting role in financial accounting and advisory or transaction advisory, or a transformation role in industry,
* Advanced skills and experience with: M\&A support, SPAC transactions, IPO readiness support, Carve\-out, GAAP conversions etc.
* Hands\-on consulting experience at a Big 4, or top tier consulting firm, or leading change programmes in industry, or leading a line function in a finance or controllership environment.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA (US) or ACCA (UK)
* 10\-13 years (post qualification) in Assurance including 5 years of Financial Accounting and Advisory experience
* Candidates with prior Big 4/Big 10 experience would be an added advantage
* Exposure to AI, data analytics and visualization tools (an added advantage)


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be part of a market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 7200 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
